blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Two neighbors will likely be roommates in jail after they were caught stealing power cables owned by the Metropolitan Cebu Water District in Barangay Jubay, Liloan town, northern Cebu. As of this posting, the two men, who are neighbors, remain detained at the Liloan Police Station, and a complaint of theft has already been filed against them. READ: 30 water meter thefts in Sept., Talisay police form task force According to police, the suspects — 21 and 26 years old — are residents of the barangay and are both without work.
